title: Workforce Project
description: File-based seed for a PROJECT#{id} row + member edges per Epic-010 §3 + §7. The runner reads PROJECT#{id}/META from DDB at invocation time; this file is the authoritative source that workforce/scripts/seed-projects.mjs writes from. `self/{slug}` projects are auto-seeded by the runner (Story 1-B) and MUST NOT have a project.json file.

id.description: Project id. Used as PROJECT#{id} partition key in DDB and wf/projects/{id}/{type} prefix in Secrets Manager. MUST match the parent directory name. MUST NOT contain '#' or '|' (asProjectId() reject). MUST NOT start with 'self/' (reserved per Epic-010 §3).

name.description: Human-readable project name surfaced in the console.

owner_agent.description: Agent slug responsible for the project's overall direction. Optional; defaults to no owner (operator-owned). Must be in members[] if set.

github.description: GitHub repo this project ships work against. Used by pr-route / pr-review handlers to resolve PR URLs against the project. The PAT used to call the API is read from wf/projects/{id}/github.token; the project membership policy gates who can invoke a skill against this project.

governance_docs.description: Optional paths (relative to the target repo's root) to governance docs that reviewer agents should ground their lens against. Examples: AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/architecture.md. Empty / omitted means reviewers fall back to generic per-persona principles only. Paths are fetched via GitHub Contents API using the project's github.token credential.

members.description: Agent slugs that participate in this project. Cross-checked against workforce/agents/. Membership is the access boundary for appendExecution() per Epic-010 §7. Soft-delete via the API/UI is independent of this file — this file declares the seed state.

credential_types.description: Credential keys this project is expected to hold in Secrets Manager under wf/projects/{id}/{type}. Declaring a type here does NOT create the secret — operator stores values via aws secretsmanager put-secret-value out of band. Validators only check the file shape. Runtime check: if a skill's `requires` lists a type not present here, the operator-onboarding runbook is incomplete; the runner will throw on getCredential() ResourceNotFoundException (no _default fallback in scoped projects).

status.description: Lifecycle. Defaults to active when omitted. archived projects are read-only (no appendExecution; existing ledger remains queryable).

created_at.description: ISO date the project was first declared in-repo.

note.description: One-line human note about why the project exists. Surfaces in the console.
